Nora (Docs): quick thread: found three glitches in the examples landing in PR #3688 (python/ts/go). Want to fix before merge.
Evan K: what are they?
Nora (Docs): 1) python streaming example doesn't show cleanup -> can hang background tasks. 2) ts retry snippet has no maxDelay/attempt cap. 3) go pagination loop doesn't guard against empty cursor.
Rina M: propose minimal fixes we can ship in one patch.
Nora (Docs): python: prefer async context manager, but show fallback.
```py
import asyncio

async def main():
    async with client.stream(prompt) as s:
        async for chunk in s:
            print(chunk)

asyncio.run(main())
```
Fallback:
```py
stream = client.stream(prompt)
async for c in stream:
    print(c)
await client.close()
```
Evan K: TS suggestion: base=200ms, factor=2, maxDelay=4500ms, attempts=6, abort on 4xx. Small comment explaining tradeoffs.
Nora (Docs): Go patch: stop on empty cursor to avoid repeating first page. Tiny snippet:
```go
resp, _ := client.List(ctx, nil)
for {
  if !resp.HasMore() { break }
  next := resp.NextCursor()
  if next == "" { break }
  resp, _ = client.List(ctx, next)
}
```
Theo (SDK): OK from SDK side. Please add a one-line unit test for Go that returns an empty cursor to prove loop exits.
Rina M: will add test and run link-check (streaming doc referenced old function-calling path).
DevX Bot: link-check queued... found 1 bad route: /docs/functions/old-calling -> replace with /docs/functions/calling-v2.
Nora (Docs): patched snippets, added Go test, updated link, and added short note in migration guide about explicit cleanup when upgrading. CI queued.
Evan K: thanks — if CI passes, land and add changelog entry under docs: "clarified streaming cleanup, retry defaults, and safe pagination".
Nora (Docs): will do. Closing thread once merged.
